text: 有记者问：我们关注到商务部今日对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查，能否介绍相关情况？答：此次调查是应国内产业申请发起的。申请人提供的初步证据显示，2022至2025年，自欧进口的对硝基甲苯产品数量处于高位，价格累计跌幅近60%，自欧倾销进口产品对中国国内产业生产经营造成了损害。根据中国法律和世贸组织规则，相关申请符合反倾销调查立案条件，中方将依法依规开展调查，充分保障各利害关系方权利，客观公正作出裁决。（央视新闻）
text_en: A reporter asked: We noted that the Ministry of Commerce today launched an anti-dumping investigation into imports of para-nitrotoluene originating in the European Union. Could you introduce the relevant situation? Answer: This investigation was initiated in response to an application from the domestic industry. Preliminary evidence provided by the applicant shows that from 2022 to 2025, the volume of para-nitrotoluene products imported from Europe remained at a high level, with prices falling by nearly 60% cumulatively, and dumped imports from Europe caused damage to the production and operations of China's domestic industry. In accordance with Chinese law and WTO rules, the relevant application meets the conditions for filing an anti-dumping investigation. China will conduct the investigation in accordance with laws and regulations, fully protect the rights of all interested parties, and make an objective and fair ruling. (CCTV News)
